resources.string: Don\'t forget to organize today\'s discoveries.
Reels, repos, articles, threads — share from any app and it lands straight in your vault.
Categories, collections, tags and priorities. Build a knowledge base that actually makes sense to you.
No account, no cloud, no tracking. Everything lives on your device, encrypted and under your control.

VaultLinks does not collect, transmit, or sell any personal data. All links, notes, and settings are stored exclusively in an encrypted local database on your device. The only network requests VaultLinks ever makes are to fetch a preview (title, description, image, favicon) for a URL you explicitly save. No analytics SDKs, no ad SDKs, and no account system are present in this application.
